display_name: 去SIG_TIME的原始与恢复双图伪标签源质量诊断
description: 冻结单seed新NoSIG E30与同契约G；只有L/U为图节点且只有L真标签作传播种子。V独立扩展，先固定预测再计质量；不训练候选，不访问目标。
authorization: 用户要求全面复盘、使用去SIG_TIME网络、优化DURA恢复IQ相关半监督；按已交付RGPL设计先做源域图标签可行性证伪，全部GPU可用。

notes: One frozen student seed01; channel realizations are not student seeds or independent votes.
NoSIG removes the whole SIG_TIME sequence_pool. Original160d default head; zero head fitting.
Frozen raw confidence<.95 defines hard pool. Both graph class probabilities>=.95, common argmax, at least3 other-RX seed groups support in each graph; ties excluded.
Cross-RX propagation excludes own-RX label seed contributions; teacher/G have seen source RX, so this is not unseen-receiver training.
Four source channel namespaces fixed before extraction. For U only matching existing restored IQ is loaded; old F features/logits are not opened.
L/V G views computed by same source generator/namespaces and G; each normalized then averaged, no IQ mixing or post-G normalization.
Source graph quality does not prove target performance. Failed scientific criterion is complete evidence, not a technical failure or reason to rerun.
Control training continues unchanged. Graph success alone never auto-launches candidate training or formal target evaluation.
